Messages.Author: Robba Yaga
Messages.Body:
Methuselah A controls Vampire X.
Vampire X bleeds Methuselah B for 2.
Methuselah B controls Vampire Y.
Vampire Y plays Telepathic Counter to reduce the bleed by 2.
Vampire X then boosts the bleed by 2.
Vampire Y then play Telepathic Misdirection to bounce the bleed to Methuselah C.
Methuselah C plays no reaction cards and does not block.
Does Methuselah C take a bleed or 2 or 4?

Thanks,
Robba Yaga

Telepathic Counter
Type: Reaction
Requires: Auspex
[aus] Reduce a bleed against you by 1.
[AUS] Reduce a bleed against you by 2.

Telepathic Misdirection
Type: Reaction
Requires: Auspex
Cost: 1 blood
[aus] +1 intercept.
[AUS] Only usable when a minion is bleeding you, after blocks are declined. Tap this reacting vampire. Choose another Methuselah other than the acting minion's controller. The acting minion is now bleeding that Methuselah.

Messages.Author: Adonai
Messages.Body:
2.

The restriction on Telepathic Counter determines when it can be played.
Once it has been played, the bleed amount is permanently reduced.
